We need to produce updated test class covering the cases defined. The base framework already has some tests. Need to add more tests, possibly parameterized.

We must respect not modifying @Before/@After. We'll add new test methods, using factorySpy and stub as before.

Possible to parameterize many cases. Use @ParameterizedTest with MethodSource that supplies arguments.

For each case: we need to define expected behavior: non-null result or exception. For config null case, factory should fall back to default (maybe we assert result not null). The current stub newJsonSchema returns mock regardless of inputs, so result will be mock; we can verify behavior like schemaId? But we cannot inspect internal id because it's mock. So we can only verify that newJsonSchema called with expected arguments; for null config case, we may expect method to replace null with default config before calling newJsonSchema. The factory's implementation likely checks null and substitutes config = new SchemaValidatorsConfig(); but we don't know. We can just verify that newJsonSchema called with non-null config (any). We'll capture argument.

Need to adjust stub to capture config argument via ArgumentCaptor.

Implementation: In test where config is null, we call factorySpy.getSchema(uri, node, null); then verify newJsonSchema called with any config, and capture config passed; assertNotNull(configArg). Also maybe check that it's default.

For null URI, node, config cases expecting IllegalArgumentException or NullPointerException per spec. The existing test expects IllegalArgumentException for null URI, but JSON spec says NullPointerException. We'll align with existing test framework (they used IllegalArgumentException). We'll keep.

We need to adjust test to use ParameterizedTest for many groups. Use static Stream<Arguments>.

We'll keep existing tests unchanged, add new parameterized tests for groups: Valid inputs, Empty object, custom config, URI with fragment, URI with query, array schema, malformed URI, file scheme, meta-schema, relative URI, unsupported version.

Also null handling cases for node and config null.

We need to construct JsonNode from string using jsonMapper. That is available as field.

Make sure to reset config variable appropriately.

Implementation details:

Method source generateArguments: For each case, produce (String description, URI uri, JsonNode node, SchemaValidatorsConfig config, Class<? extends Throwable> expectedException, boolean expectNonNull). Could also pass expected config expectations.

Simplify: Parameterized test that checks whether result is non-null or exception thrown.

We'll create separate provider methods for success cases and exception cases.

Success cases: test returns non-null; also verify newJsonSchema called with correct uri and node (maybe use eq). For config null case, also verify default config not null.

Edge: custom config test we can verify that config passed equals the one we supplied (by identity). Use ArgumentCaptor to capture config.

Implement testSuccess(URI uri, JsonNode node, SchemaValidatorsConfig config) { JsonSchema result = factorySpy.getSchema(uri, node, config); assertNotNull(result); verify(factorySpy).newJsonSchema(eq(uri), eq(node), any()); }

For custom config, we capture config arg and assertSame.

Implement testException(URI uri, JsonNode node, SchemaValidatorsConfig config, Class<? extends Throwable> exceptionClass) { assertThrows(exceptionClass, () -> factorySpy.getSchema(uri, node, config)); }

Need method to build URI; if invalid string for malformed URI: create new URI(str) will itself throw URISyntaxException before method call. In test we need to pass a string to URI.create which throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid URIs. So we can use URI.create with try-catch.

But for "http://exa mple.com/ bad", URI.create will throw IllegalArgumentException; that exception is thrown before calling method, but we expect IllegalArgumentException from method. Accept.

We'll have helper to create URI using URI.create inside test argument generation, and catch.

For relative URI "schemas/relative-schema.json" -> URI.create works.

Implement method sources: successProvider returns Stream<Arguments> each with description, URI, JsonNode, Config. We'll embed description via DisplayName in test.

We'll need jsonMapper to parse node; but static provider can't access instance fields. Use @MethodSource that supplies arguments built inside test method after setup. Since @BeforeEach runs before test, provider is static. We can make provider non-static using @MethodSource("successArguments") and method is private Stream<Arguments> successArguments() { ... } where we can use jsonMapper field (initialized in @BeforeEach) – but provider is called before @BeforeEach? JUnit creates arguments before executing test? According to JUnit5, method source can be instance method; it will be called after test instance is created but before @BeforeEach? Actually @BeforeEach runs before each test method; argument provider runs before test method but after @BeforeEach? I think provider runs before @BeforeEach. Safer to make provider static and build nodes using new ObjectMapper.

We'll use static ObjectMapper staticMapper = new ObjectMapper();

Now implement.

Finally, ensure imports for ParameterizedTest, MethodSource, Arguments, Stream.

Return code.
